levels.surface: يزيد بن عبد الله بن قسيط
داود بن عامر بن سعد بن أبي وقاص

notes: Abu Hurayra is the last link: Khabbab quotes him as hearing the Prophet, and his words are the saying; Ibn Umar and Aisha speak in the scene and are not links (rule 6)
«- وهو حميد بن زياد -» is an editor gloss and is left out; «فذكر معنى حديث سفيان» points to another wording and is not a route
